# Flizy

> WhatsApp-native EVM wallet. Trusted sends. GIWA-first.

## Site

- / : Product home and four-step overview
- /how-it-works : Full user guide and commands
- /docs : Why trusted addresses exist (security)
- /signup : Create account
- /login : Sign in
- /dashboard : Wallet, PIN, trusted people, WhatsApp link code
- /claim/:token : Claim funds waiting for non-users

## When to read

- Read /how-it-works to onboard a human user.
- Read /docs when a WhatsApp send is rejected for destination policy.
- Read /dashboard flows for link codes and trusted address management.
